name: Pan con Tomate (Spanish Tomato Bread) with Ham & Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and mince tomato; place in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tomato
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan and drizzle oil over both sides; sprinkle tops with garlic. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven (keep oven on).
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, and Dijon in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp honey
1 tsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Wash spinach (skip if it came pre-washed) and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Spread tomato mixture over toasts and return to the oven. Bake until tomato topping is heated through, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
Halve olives. Cut or tear prosciutto into bite sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
6 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toasts and salad between plates. Top salad with olives, prosciutto, and almonds. Enjoy!
